[[File:UrnsoriSoulleecher-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Urnsor'is SoulLeecher]]
The '''Urnsor'is SoulLeecher''' was a unique one-handed [[Sword/Legends|sword]] made from some unknown part of the vicious [[urnsor'is]] creatures of the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] world of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was created by the [[Myyydril]] tribe who lived in the caverns. It was gifted to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] by [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Kallaarac]] after the spacer killed an especially ferocious Urnsor'is known as "[[Mother Queen]]."
